description: Block edits on sensitive files (.env, secrets, credentials). Audit 2026-06-24 — fixed broken `echo '$TOOL_INPUT'` pattern (single quotes prevent expansion; $TOOL_INPUT is not a shell env var — Claude Code passes hook input on stdin as JSON).

hooks.command: FILEPATH=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if printf '%s' "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE '(\.env|\.env\.|credentials|secrets|private.*key|id_rsa)'; then printf 'BLOCKED: Cannot edit sensitive file: %s\n' "$FILEPATH" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

FILEPATH=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if printf '%s' "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE '(\.env|\.env\.|credentials|secrets|private.*key|id_rsa)'; then printf 'BLOCKED: Cannot write sensitive file: %s\n' "$FILEPATH" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

usage: Copy the PreToolUse hooks to .claude/settings.json. Claude Code passes the hook payload on stdin as JSON — the command reads it via jq. Exit code 2 blocks the tool call and shows the stderr message to Claude. Adjust the regex to match your project's sensitive files. Requires jq.
